content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Cannabis grower-manufacturer and brand owner selling branded cannabis products wholesale, matching the target's core cannabis product business."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Vertically integrated cannabis company making and branding flower, vapes, edibles and tinctures, with wholesale to dispensaries like the target."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Generic prescription drug developer and contract manufacturer; it shares no cannabis products, customers or model with the target."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Restaurant operator and franchisor selling prepared food and liquor to local diners, a different business from cannabis products."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Supermarket and fuel-center operator selling groceries to households; different products, customers and value chain from the target."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Cannabis grower-processor and brand owner making its own cannabis products, though it sells mainly through its own retail stores."}]}
